issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Kane CLI
products.tagline: Natural language browser & mobile app tests from terminal
products.summaryZh: 终端中的自然语言浏览器与移动应用测试
products.descriptionZh: 面向开发者和AI编程代理的智能质量验证工具。用自然语言描述测试，Kane CLI会在真实Chrome浏览器中运行，并返回通过或失败结果及可分享的证明。无需编写选择器。本地优先，免费起步。
products.description: An agentic quality verifier for developers and AI coding agents. Describe a test in natural language, and Kane CLI runs it in a real Chrome browser and returns pass or fail with shareable proof. No selectors to write. Local-first, free to start.

products.name: Ito
products.tagline: AI code review that runs your code
products.summaryZh: 运行你的代码的AI代码审查
products.descriptionZh: Ito是一款AI代码审查工具，在审查代码之前会先运行你的应用。对于每个拉取请求，Ito会启动一个临时环境，验证受影响的流程，并返回运行时证据，帮助团队捕获静态分析和仅依赖模型的审查者遗漏的bug。Ito不是根据差异猜测，而是在PR进入生产环境之前，展示实际出了什么问题、发生在哪里以及为何重要。
products.description: Ito is an AI code review tool that runs your app before it reviews the code. For every pull request, Ito spins up an ephemeral environment, validates impacted flows, and returns runtime evidence so teams can catch bugs that static analysis and model-only reviewers miss. Instead of guessing from diffs, Ito shows what actually broke, where it happened, and why it matters before the PR reaches production.

products.name: Nuphos
products.tagline: The AI-Native DevOps Workspace.
products.summaryZh: AI原生DevOps工作空间。
products.descriptionZh: Nuphos为工程团队提供了一个共享环境，让AI代理能够学习你的基础设施、调查问题并操作生产系统。
products.description: Nuphos gives engineering teams a shared environment where AI agents can learn your infrastructure, investigate issues, and operate production systems.

products.name: Scrimba Explain
products.tagline: Ask any question, get a video back instantly
products.summaryZh: 提出任何问题，即刻获得视频解答。
products.descriptionZh: Scrimba Explain 能针对你提出的几乎任何问题，即时生成带讲解的视频教程。你可以上传文件、添加链接、粘贴代码，或直接写下你想理解的内容。由于我们采用了基于 DOM 的播放技术，其速度远超任何视频生成模型。视频讲解可包含图片、代码演示、动画、图表及其他视觉辅助元素，并配有旁白、字幕和光标，使其体验更接近 YouTube，而非传统聊天机器人界面。
products.description: Scrimba Explain generates a narrated video tutorial about almost anything you ask, instantly. You can upload files, add links, paste code, or just write what you’re trying to understand. It's MUCH faster than any of the video generation models, as we utilise our DOM-based playback technology. The video explainer can include images, code walkthroughs, animations, diagrams, and other visual aids, plus voiceover, captions and cursor so it feels more like YouTube than traditional chatbot UX.

products.name: Human Behavior
products.tagline: Product analytics told you what happened. We handle it.
products.summaryZh: 产品分析告诉你发生了什么。我们来处理。
products.descriptionZh: 仪表盘是洞察力消亡之地。人类行为闭环：1）收集。我们的SDK捕获事件、错误和会话回放。2）理解。AI观看每一次回放，捕捉愤怒点击、失效按钮和无声放弃。3）行动。后台代理邮件联系客户，更新Linear和CRM，并附上回放作为证据开启PR。4）循环。代理检查结果，持续改进产品——自主进行。无需照看仪表盘。一切都在Slack或短信中呈现。
products.description: Dashboards are where insights go to die. Human Behavior closes the loop: 1) Collect. Our SDK captures your events, errors, and session replays. 2) Understand. AI watches every replay, catching rage clicks, dead buttons, and silent give-ups. 3) Act. Background agents email the customer, update Linear and your CRM, and open PRs with the replay as evidence. 4) Loop. Agents check the results and keep the product improving — on its own. No dashboard to babysit. It all lives in Slack or SMS.

products.name: Oasis
products.tagline: Where humans and agents come to work.
products.summaryZh: 人类与智能体共同工作的场所。
products.descriptionZh: 一个智能工作空间，为你、你的所有代理和你的团队而设。将生态系统中最好的代理汇聚一处，人与代理作为平等队友协同工作。每一次对话、决策和成果都成为随时间累积的共享知识。随着工作空间学习你的工作方式，它会适应你的需求，并构建专门工具，帮助每个人发挥最佳表现。
products.description: An intelligent workspace for you, all your agents, and your team. Bring the best agents from across the ecosystem into one place, where people and agents work together as equal teammates. Every conversation, decision, and artifact becomes shared knowledge that compounds over time. As the workspace learns how you work, it adapts to your needs and builds specialized tools that help everyone do its best work.

products.name: Skilldocs
products.tagline: Figma for markdown
products.summaryZh: Figma 的 Markdown 版本
products.descriptionZh: 打开一个技能，所有人即刻同步参与——实时光标、内联评论，以及随输入即时渲染的编辑器。随后，将整个对话与差异补丁交还给智能体。
products.description: Open a skill, and everyone is in it at once - real cursors, inline comments, and an editor that renders as you type. Then hand the whole conversation + diff back to the agent.

products.name: Caveman
products.tagline: why use many token when few do trick
products.summaryZh: 为何要用大量token，几个就够了。
products.descriptionZh: 一条命令即可将Claude Code、Codex、Hermes等工具封装于本地代理中，该代理在每次提供商调用前压缩日志、工具输出和文件。在固定的54次运行基准测试中：输入令牌减少33.2%，且18/18项正确性检查全部通过。Caveman还能通过将文本加载为图像，以约70%更少的令牌运行任何现有代理技能。基于开源生态系统构建，GitHub星标超过97K。
products.description: One command wraps Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and more with a local proxy that compresses logs, tool output, and files before every provider call. In a pinned 54-run benchmark: 33.2% fewer input tokens with 18/18 correctness checks. Caveman can also run any existing agent skill with ~70% fewer tokens by loading text as images. Built on an open-source ecosystem with 97K+ GitHub stars.

products.name: Kitbitz
products.tagline: 2K+ free hand-drawn illustrations for your projects, CC0
products.summaryZh: 2K+ 免费手绘插画，适用于你的项目，CC0 许可
products.descriptionZh: 一个包含2000多个手绘素材的免费CC0库，涵盖13个主题套件。可单独下载SVG和PNG文件，或获取完整的Figma社区库，内含可复用组件、颜色变量及灵活可调整大小的素材。适用于游戏、应用、地图、插画及趣味小世界创作。我们还在围绕该库开发Figma插件、MCP支持及世界构建工具。
products.description: A free CC0 library of 2,000+ hand-drawn assets across 13 themed kits. Download individual SVGs and PNGs, or grab the full Figma Community libraries with reusable components, color variables and flexible, resizable assets. Use them for games, apps, maps, illustrations and playful little worlds. We’re also building a Figma plugin, MCP support and world-building tools around the library.

products.name: Mem Agent
products.tagline: The AI that refuses to let you drop the ball
products.summaryZh: 绝不让您错失良机的AI
products.descriptionZh: 重要交付物，或是为某天意大利之旅收藏的披萨店——Mem Agent会记住你告诉它的内容，以及笔记和会议中的待办事项，并积极跟进确保落实。借助Push-to-Remember功能，无需离开工作界面，一键即可将想法无缝保存至Mem，或随时调出已存信息。
products.description: An important deliverable, or a pizza place saved for that someday trip to Italy—Mem Agent keeps track of what you tell it, plus the todos living inside your notes and meetings, sharply following up so it actually happens. And with Push-to-Remember, seamlessly capture a thought into Mem or recall something you saved with a single button—all without leaving your work.

products.name: FluidDocs CLI
products.tagline: Publish interactive docs that answer and report back
products.summaryZh: 发布交互式文档，用于解答问题并反馈结果。
products.descriptionZh: FluidDocs CLI将您的提示词转化为交互式文档，既能回答问题，也能反馈信息。您可以查看谁打开了文档、阅读进度以及他们提出的问题。适用于演示文稿、提案、报告和董事会更新。一行命令安装CLI，一条命令即可发布。后续可通过提示词编辑，同一链接自动更新。内置面向查看者的AI问答与分析功能。
products.description: FluidDocs CLI turns your prompts into interactive documents that answer questions and report back. You see who opened it, how far they got, and what they asked. Pitch decks, proposals, reports, board updates. One line installs the CLI and one command publishes. Edit later by prompt, and the same link updates. Viewer-side AI-enabled Q&A and analytics come built in.

products.name: WebBrain
products.tagline: The sidebar agent for the rest of us
products.summaryZh: 面向我们其余人的侧边栏代理
products.descriptionZh: 你的浏览器，你的模型，你的数据。WebBrain 是一款免费、开源的 AI 浏览器代理，适用于 Chromium 浏览器和 Firefox。通过 llama.cpp 在本地运行，大多数查询无需任何费用——你的数据绝不会离开设备。它从侧边栏直接读取页面、提取数据并自动化任务。偏好云端？可自带 OpenAI、Claude、OpenRouter 或 100 多个兼容 OpenAI 的提供商的 API 密钥。多语言界面，注重 token 的截图。MIT 许可证。
products.description: Your browser, your models, your data. WebBrain is a free, open-source AI browser agent for Chromium browsers and Firefox. Run it locally with llama.cpp and most queries cost nothing — your data never leaves your device. It reads pages, extracts data, and automates tasks right from the sidebar. Prefer the cloud? Bring your own API key for OpenAI, Claude, OpenRouter, or 100+ OpenAI-compatible providers. Multilingual UI, token-conscious screenshots. MIT licensed.

products.name: Execlave
products.tagline: The gate between your AI agents and the real world
products.summaryZh: 你的AI智能体与现实世界之间的门户
products.descriptionZh: Execlave是一个AI代理治理与执行平台（运行时AMP），位于自主代理与真实系统之间，在每次操作前而非事件发生后执行策略。它为平台和安全团队提供运行时策略执行、紧急停止开关及审计就绪追踪，确保每个代理操作均经过授权、可追溯，并符合SOC 2、欧盟AI法案、ISO 27001及其他企业框架的要求。
products.description: Execlave is an AI Agent Governance and Enforcement platform (runtime AMP) that sits between autonomous agents and your real systems, enforcing policy before every action instead of after incidents. It gives platform and security teams runtime policy enforcement, kill switches, and audit-ready trails so every agent action is authorized, traceable, and compliant with SOC 2, EU AI Act, ISO 27001, and other enterprise frameworks.

products.name: Qencode MCP
products.tagline: Let AI agents transcode and process video
products.summaryZh: 让AI智能体转码并处理视频
products.descriptionZh: Qencode让AI助手能够通过自然语言对视频进行转码、分析、编辑、优化和交付，这一切由云端视频处理平台提供支持。
products.description: Qencode lets AI assistants transcode, analyze, edit, optimize, and deliver video using natural language, powered by a cloud video processing platform.

products.name: Insta360 X6
products.tagline: A 360 camera, gimbal, and 3D scanner in one
products.summaryZh: 360度相机、云台与3D扫描仪三合一
products.descriptionZh: Insta360 X6是一款旗舰级8K全景相机，配备双1/1.1英寸索尼传感器，支持8K50视频、10位色彩、140分钟8K30录制时长，并内置存储。其全新PanoMind模型和AI Director能够自动识别精彩片段、选择拍摄角度，将360度素材转化为可直接分享的短片。
products.description: Insta360 X6 is a flagship 8K 360 camera with dual 1/1.1" Sony sensors, 8K50 video, 10-bit color, 140 minutes of 8K30 recording, and built-in storage. Its new PanoMind model and AI Director can find highlights, choose angles, and turn 360 footage into ready-to-share clips.

products.name: Kin Health
products.tagline: Record doctor visits and get clear summaries
products.summaryZh: 记录医生就诊情况，获取清晰摘要。
products.descriptionZh: Kin 助您准备医疗预约、记录对话内容，并在事后跟进，让您在就诊时能专注于当下，无需记笔记或事后费力回忆。每次就诊后，Kin 会将对话整理成重点摘要。它不会提供逐字记录，而是归纳关键要点、建议和后续步骤，让您快速了解就诊情况与下一步行动。
products.description: Kin helps you prepare for healthcare appointments, capture the conversation, and follow through afterward so you can stay present during the visit instead of taking notes or trying to remember everything later. After each visit, Kin turns the conversation into a focused summary. Rather than giving you a word-for-word transcript, Kin organizes the key points, recommendations, and next steps so you can quickly understand what happened and what to do next.

products.name: Patience
products.tagline: The only mechanic is waiting. The only currency is time.
products.summaryZh: 唯一的机制是等待。唯一的货币是时间。
products.descriptionZh: 一款极简iOS游戏，其全部机制在于等待。黑屏上，一个圆圈在不可预测的延迟后出现——及时点击它，否则从第1关重新开始。全球排行榜，以及由你每等待100毫秒构建的粒子可视化效果。
products.description: A minimalist iOS game where the entire mechanic is waiting. A circle appears on a black screen after an unpredictable delay — tap it in time, or restart from Level 1. Global leaderboard and a particle visualization built from every 100ms you spent waiting.

products.name: Dishylink
products.tagline: Open-source Starlink monitoring app for Mac, Windows and Web
products.summaryZh: 适用于Mac、Windows和Web的开源Starlink监控应用
products.descriptionZh: Starlink官方应用仅限手机端，旧版网页门户已于2024年关闭且无替代。Dishylink以原生桌面应用的形式将其带回，通过本地网络读取你的天线和路由器。功能包括：实时统计、角度对准、3D卫星视图、遮挡延时摄影、按设备数据用量、功耗及每日和每月历史记录，以及自动清除的警报。它免费、开源，无需账户，不依赖云端，支持macOS、Windows和浏览器。
products.description: Starlink's own app is phone-only, and the old web portal was switched off in 2024 with nothing to replace it. Dishylink brings that back as a native desktop app. It reads your dish and router over your own network. Features include: live stats, alignment in degrees, a 3D satellite view, obstruction time lapse, per-device data usage, power draw with daily and monthly history, and alerts that clear themselves. It's free, open source, no account, no cloud, and works on macOS, Windows and browsers.

products.name: Google Pixel 11
products.tagline: Your most personal Pixel yet
products.summaryZh: 你迄今为止最个性化的Pixel。
products.descriptionZh: 探索Google Pixel 11系列，搭载升级的相机硬件、Tensor G6芯片、LED HiLight通知及更快的Gemini AI支持。
products.description: Discover the Google Pixel 11 lineup featuring updated camera hardware, the Tensor G6 chip, LED HiLight notifications and faster Gemini AI support.

products.name: Coarena by Coasty
products.tagline: The arena where agents battle on real-world work
products.summaryZh: 智能体在真实工作中竞技的舞台
products.descriptionZh: Coarena让AI代理在真实计算机任务中竞争，而非合成基准测试。并排观看多个模型完成相同工作流程，比较速度、准确性和可靠性，然后投票选出胜者。发现哪个代理在浏览器、应用和企业软件的日常工作中表现最佳。
products.description: Coarena lets AI agents compete on real computer tasks, not synthetic benchmarks. Watch multiple models complete the same workflow side by side, compare speed, accuracy, and reliability, then vote for the winner. Discover which agent actually performs best on everyday work across browsers, apps, and enterprise software.
